subject: QuantaOps / Redwood — account split & integration mapping for MinerX
thread_summary: QuantaOps asks to align on account/territory ownership for the upcoming MinerX integration. We exchanged a draft mapping, flagged EU accounts and co-sell questions, and set an internal follow-up to finalize routing and SOW items.
messages:
From: Kara Singh <kara@quantaops.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: partnerships@quantaops.com
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: QuantaOps + Redwood: territory/account mapping for MinerX integration

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our product + partnerships teams scoped the MinerX connector and we want to align on who owns which accounts and the go-to-market motion (co-sell vs. referral) before we push to customers. Attached is a first-pass territory_matrix_v1.xlsx that maps our active pipeline against the regions and overlap we saw in HubSpot.

Key asks from our side:
- Can Redwood confirm which accounts you consider "owned" vs "shared" for co-sell? We highlighted ~18 accounts as potential overlap.
- Any constraints on handling EU accounts (data residency / procurement cadence) for dedicated deployments?
- Would you be open to a short joint mapping call next week (30m) to finalize a split and agree on an SOW cadence?

We propose Wed Aug 5 at 10am PT but can be flexible. I attached the matrix and a quick summary.

Thanks,
Kara Singh
Head of Partnerships, QuantaOps
K: 415-555-0192
Attachment: territory_matrix_v1.xlsx

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Kara Singh <kara@quantaops.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuantaOps + Redwood: territory/account mapping for MinerX integration

Kara —

Appreciate the matrix. Marissa and Jonas are looped on GTM and technical handoff respectively. Quick responses inline, plus proposed next steps.

Inline:
- Ownership: from our preliminary CRM join I marked accounts where Redwood has an active contract or POC as "Redwood-owned" and the rest as "shared". I exported a draft (redwood_quantaops_draft_map.xlsx) with flags for co-sell recommended accounts.
- EU accounts: there are two that will need Private deployment or a dedicated region due to procurement language — we can surface that in the SOW. For now mark them as "needs legal/KMS review".
- Call: Wed Aug 5 at 10am PT works for Redwood. Can we ask for an agenda: account-by-account ownership, co-sell motion, and a short SOW run-through (timeline + billing)?

Action items (for meeting):
1) QuantaOps to validate any customer objections to co-sell on the 18 highlighted accounts (Kara).
2) Redwood to produce cleaned draft map + SOW stub (Stephanie / Marissa) — I attached the draft map.
3) Jonas will prepare a short checklist for EU/data residency items so we can decide on Private vs Hosted options.

See you Wed — I'll send an invite in a separate thread.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood_quantaops_draft_map.xlsx

From: Kara Singh <kara@quantaops.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: partnerships@quantaops.com
Date: 2026-08-03T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QuantaOps + Redwood: territory/account mapping for MinerX integration

Thanks Stephanie — quick notes after reviewing the draft and checking with our AMs.

We have 3 EU customers (ACME Logistics EU, Baltic Mining Co., and NordSec) that explicitly require on-prem or EU-hosted data. If Redwood flags them as "needs KMS/legal", we should treat those as priority for a Private deployment clause in the SOW.

Also: for 6 accounts you marked as "Redwood-owned" we have active co-marketing commitments from last quarter; our sales ops requests that those remain shared until EOY unless Redwood has a signed renewal (so the status should be "shared (marketing locked)").

I attached a short feedback PDF with the AM notes. Also — here's the HubSpot link to the combined opportunity so we have a single reference: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4379.

Can the SOW include a two-week pipeline review checkpoint and an option for a pilot co-sell bundle? We'll talk more on Wed.

-Kara
Attachment: QuantaOps_feedback.pdf

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-06T15:34:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: QuantaOps + Redwood: territory/account mapping for MinerX integration 

Team — summary and internal asks after Kara's feedback:

Summary:
- QuantaOps confirmed 3 EU customers require Private or EU-hosted options. They want those treated as priority for SOW changes.
- QuantaOps requests 6 accounts we marked as Redwood-owned stay "shared (marketing locked)" until EOY unless we have signed renewals.
- They want a 2-week pipeline checkpoint and a pilot co-sell bundle option in SOW.

Immediate asks (owners):
- Marissa: update the draft SOW to include a Private deployment clause for EU customers and the 2-week checkpoint + pilot option. Use QuantaOps_SOW_v1.pdf as base and track redlines. (ETA: Tue 8/10 EOD)
- Jonas: produce the technical checklist for EU customers (KMS/HSM, region, procurement notes) and confirm whether the 3 named accounts can be supported in our EU region or will require on-prem. (ETA: Mon 8/9 noon PT)
- Marissa & Stephanie: finalize the account map to switch the 6 contested accounts to "shared (marketing locked)" pending contract triggers. We'll present the final map back to QuantaOps on the Wed call.

I'll incorporate Kara's PDF feedback into the map before the call and send the invite. If either of you sees a major pushback risk on the pilot pricing, flag it in advance.

Thanks,
Stephanie
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
